title: Segment
description: One fixed time segment of a video (D006). Labels attach to segments. One JSON object per line in data/segments/<topic>.jsonl.

segment_id.description: <video_id>_<start in ms>; never changes after annotation starts

asr_system.description: Exact system and version, e.g. whisper-<size>-<version>

text_caption.description: YouTube automatic caption text inside the segment, if available

text_corrected.description: Manually corrected text, edited inside the same boundaries (test set)
